[SWS_DM_00154] Number of extended data for a DTC
⌈
The DM shall store
zero or one extended data for a DTC. Extended data consists of extended data
records. If at least one DiagnosticTroubleCodeProps.extendedDataRecord
is configured for the corresponding DTC, the extended data shall be present in the event
memory entry.
